method: Matched the first 100 current hold decisions to exact source IDs and full source example sentences. interpretation: No new exclusion is safe from this slice under the narrow user rule. Several complete phrasings are tailored or awkward, but their sentences may contain teachable smaller units or same-sense owner routes. Keep all 100 on editorial hold for bounded target/owner or source-form review; do not silently drop them.
